body_sections.name: Chest
body_sections.description: Pectoralis major and minor muscles, responsible for pushing movements.

body_sections.name: Back
body_sections.description: Latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, trapezius, and erector spinae, responsible for pulling movements.

body_sections.name: Shoulders
body_sections.description: Deltoids (anterior, lateral, posterior) and rotator cuff muscles.

body_sections.name: Biceps
body_sections.description: Biceps brachii on the front of the upper arm, responsible for elbow flexion.

body_sections.name: Triceps
body_sections.description: Triceps brachii on the back of the upper arm, responsible for elbow extension.

body_sections.name: Quads
body_sections.description: Quadriceps femoris on the front of the thigh, responsible for knee extension.

body_sections.name: Hamstrings
body_sections.description: Hamstring group on the back of the thigh, responsible for knee flexion.

body_sections.name: Glutes
body_sections.description: Gluteus maximus, medius, and minimus, responsible for hip extension and stabilization.

body_sections.name: Calves
body_sections.description: Gastrocnemius and soleus muscles of the lower leg, responsible for plantar flexion.

body_sections.name: Abs
body_sections.description: Rectus abdominis, obliques, and core muscles, responsible for stabilization and flexion.

body_sections.name: Forearms
body_sections.description: Brachioradialis and wrist flexor/extensor muscles of the lower arms.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Lie flat on a bench, lower a barbell to your chest, and push it up until arms are locked.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Press a barbell upward on a 30 to 45 degree incline bench to target upper chest fibers.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Press a barbell upward on a decline bench to target lower chest fibers.

exercises.name: Flat Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Lie on a flat bench and press dumbbells upwards from chest level.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Lie on an incline bench, press dumbbells from shoulder level upwards until arms are extended.

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Lie on a decline bench and press dumbbells upwards to target the lower chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.description: Lie on a flat bench, lower dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc, then bring them back together.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
exercises.description: Perform a fly movement on an incline bench to target the upper chest area.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.description: Stand between two pulleys, grab handles, and bring hands together in a wide arc to target the chest.

exercises.name: Pec Dec Fly
exercises.description: Sit at the machine and bring the padded arm levers together in front of your chest.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.description: Place hands shoulder-width apart, keep body straight, lower chest to floor, and push back up.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.description: Suspend body on parallel bars, lean forward slightly, lower body by bending elbows, and press up.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: Lift a loaded barbell off the ground to hip level, keeping the back straight and using the hips and legs.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.description: Perform a deadlift with a very wide stance and hands gripping the bar inside the knees.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.description: Hang from a bar and pull your body up until your chin clears the bar, focusing on the back muscles.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.description: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and pull body up until chin clears the bar.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Sit at a pulldown station and pull the bar down to your upper chest, engaging the latissimus dorsi.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
exercises.description: Hinge at the hips, hold a barbell, and pull it to your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.description: Support knee and hand on a bench, pull a dumbbell up to hip level with one arm.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.description: Straddle a landmine barbell with a handle attached, pull the weight toward your abdomen.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: Sit at a cable station, pull the handle toward your lower stomach while keeping back straight.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
exercises.description: Stand at a cable station, keep arms straight, and pull the bar down to your thighs.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.description: Lie face down on a hyperextension bench, lower torso, then raise it using lower back muscles.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.description: Hold a barbell in front of thighs and shrug shoulders upward to target trapezius muscles.

exercises.name: Overhead Barbell Press
exercises.description: Press a barbell from shoulder height directly overhead while standing, keeping the core tight.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Sit on a bench with back support, press dumbbells overhead from shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Stand and raise dumbbells to your sides until arms are parallel to the floor, targeting lateral deltoids.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Stand next to a low pulley and pull the cable across your body out to the side.

exercises.name: Front Dumbbell Raise
exercises.description: Raise dumbbells one at a time or together in front of you to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description: Press dumbbells overhead starting with palms facing you and rotating them outward as you press.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise
exercises.description: Bend forward at the hips and raise dumbbells to your sides to target posterior deltoids.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: Pull a cable rope attachment toward your face, flare elbows out, and squeeze rear shoulders.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.description: Pull a barbell or dumbbells straight up in front of your body toward your chin, raising elbows.

exercises.name: Barbell Bicep Curl
exercises.description: Hold a barbell with an underhand grip and curl it upwards towards shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at sides, curl weights up towards shoulders by flexing the elbows.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells with a neutral grip (palms facing) and curl them up, targeting brachialis and biceps.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.description: Rest upper arms on a slanted preacher bench, curl barbell or dumbbells upwards.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.description: Sit on a bench, rest elbow against inner thigh, curl dumbbell upward focusing on bicep peak.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curl
exercises.description: Perform bicep curls using a straight bar or rope attachment on a low cable pulley.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: Sit on a 45-degree incline bench and curl dumbbells to stretch the long head of the biceps.

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.description: Lie chest down on a preacher bench and curl a barbell hanging straight down.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.description: Push a cable attachment down until arms are fully extended at your sides, squeezing the triceps.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
exercises.description: Face away from a high pulley, pull a rope attachment forward and overhead until arms extend.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.description: Lie on a bench, lower a barbell or dumbbells toward your forehead by bending at the elbows, then extend.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Perform a bench press with hands spaced closer together to focus load onto the triceps.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
exercises.description: Hold a single dumbbell with both hands overhead, lower it behind your head, then extend arms.

exercises.name: Tricep Dip
exercises.description: Suspend body on parallel bars, lower body vertically by bending elbows, and push back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Kickback
exercises.description: Hinge forward, hold upper arm parallel to torso, and extend arm backward to straighten elbow.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.description: Rest a barbell on your upper back, bend hips and knees to lower your body, then stand back up.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.description: Rest a barbell on the front of your shoulders, lower hips into a squat, and push back up.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically against your chest and perform a deep squat.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: Sit in a leg press machine and push the platform away from you using your legs.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.description: Perform squats on a hack squat machine, which stabilizes your back and focuses load on quads.

exercises.name: Barbell Lunge
exercises.description: Rest a barbell on shoulders, step forward with one leg, lower hips until back knee near floor, push up.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.description: Place rear foot on a bench behind you, hold dumbbells, and squat down with front leg.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.description: Sit in extension machine, place shins behind roller pad, and extend knees fully.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: Hold a barbell, hinge forward at hips with slight knee bend, lower bar to shins, and pull back up.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.description: Lie face down on a leg curl machine and curl the roller pad toward your glutes.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.description: Sit in machine, place legs over roller, and pull pad down and back toward your thighs.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.description: Hook ankles in a GHR machine, lower torso forward, and pull yourself up using hamstrings and glutes.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.description: Rest barbell on upper back, bend forward at hips with straight back, then stand up.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.description: Rest upper back on bench, place loaded barbell over hips, and drive hips upward squeezing glutes.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat, and lift hips up toward ceiling.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
exercises.description: Attach ankle cuff to low pulley and kick leg straight back behind you.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.description: Rise up on the balls of your feet against resistance, stretching and contracting the calf muscles.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.description: Sit at machine with pad on thighs, lift heels to raise weight, targeting soleus calf muscle.

exercises.name: Calf Press on Leg Press
exercises.description: Place balls of feet on lower edge of leg press platform and push platform away by extending ankles.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Hold a push-up position on your forearms, keeping your body in a straight line to engage the core.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.description: Lie on side supported by elbow, lift hips off floor to align body in straight line.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.description: Hang from a pull-up bar and raise your knees toward your chest, engaging the lower abdominals.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: Hang from bar and raise legs straight up until they are parallel to floor.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.description: Kneel on floor, hold ab wheel, and roll forward as far as possible keeping core locked.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.description: Kneel beneath high pulley, hold rope behind neck, and crunch downward contracting abdominals.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.description: Lie on back and perform a pedaling motion, touching opposite elbow to opposite knee.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.description: Sit on floor with knees bent and feet slightly raised, twist torso from side to side.

exercises.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
exercises.description: Rest forearms on bench holding a barbell palms up, curl wrists upward.

exercises.name: Reverse Barbell Wrist Curl
exercises.description: Rest forearms on bench holding a barbell palms down, curl wrists upward.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
exercises.description: Pick up heavy dumbbells and walk forward for distance, building grip and core stability.
